hero.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Everything you need to know about JURIJOB: our approach, pricing, timelines, and methodology.

q1.question: What exactly is JURIJOB?
q1.answer: JURIJOB is a legal profile selection platform in Morocco and Africa. Our role is to deliver a qualified shortlist matching your criteria — specialization, languages, experience, degree. The interview, assessment, and final decision remain in your hands: we save you considerable time by identifying the most relevant profiles.

q2.question: How does JURIJOB differ from a traditional recruitment agency?
q2.answer: A traditional recruitment agency charges on a success basis, often 15% to 25% of the hired candidate's annual salary — representing tens of thousands of dirhams for a senior legal counsel. JURIJOB charges 1,490 MAD excl. VAT per delivered profile, with no subscription and no placement commission. We are not compensated based on hiring success, but on the quality of selection — allowing us to remain objective and offer a cost-controlled service, even for recurring needs.

q3.question: Who is behind JURIJOB?
q3.answer: JURIJOB is backed by Sentissi Legal Advisory (SLA), a firm founded by Mohammed Sentissi — legal expert, former Legal Director of holdings in Morocco and Africa, and elected President of the Moroccan Corporate Counsel Association (AMJE - in formation). The service relies on 24 years of experience in legal management and a network of tens of thousands of professional contacts.

q1.question: How much does a shortlist cost?
q1.answer: 1,490 MAD excl. VAT per delivered profile (1,788 MAD incl. VAT). You choose the desired number of profiles when making your request, and the total amount is communicated before any payment — so you know exactly what you commit. No subscription, no commission on the hired candidate's salary. If no profile in our CV database matches your criteria, no shortlist is delivered and you pay nothing. Volume pricing applies for five or more profiles: email us at recrutement@sentissilegal.com for a customized quote.

q2.question: When and how is payment made?
q2.answer: You only pay after receiving your shortlist. Payment is made via bank transfer: bank details and a unique reference are provided in your recruiter dashboard. Once the transfer is submitted and confirmed by our team — usually within 24 business hours — full candidate profiles are unlocked: identity, contact details, career background, and experience. Profiles remain locked until payment is confirmed.

q3.question: How does JURIJOB select candidates?
q3.answer: We apply a rigorous methodology based on practical legal expertise. Our scoring algorithm evaluates each profile across four key dimensions: legal specializations, languages, experience, and degrees. Each shortlist is then manually validated by a former Legal Director before delivery to the employer.

q4.question: What is the turnaround time to receive my shortlist?
q4.answer: Within 48 business hours after request validation. This timeframe covers the complete workflow: analyzing your criteria, searching our CV database and professional network, manual evaluation of profiles, and curating a concise, qualified shortlist.

q5.question: What happens if none of the shortlisted candidates fit my needs?
q5.answer: Write to us at recrutement@sentissilegal.com. Depending on the nature of your requirement, we can direct you to a complementary executive search service with tailored pricing. We remain available to refine your search.

q6.question: Do you offer special rates for recurring recruitment needs?
q6.answer: Yes. For companies and firms with multiple legal recruitments per year, we offer volume-based pricing. Contact us at recrutement@sentissilegal.com for a personalized quote.

q1.question: How do you guarantee confidentiality?
q1.answer: Discretion is central to our ethics. Each candidate profile is securely hosted and only accessible to recruiters with confirmed payment — no public exposure. Our platform complies with Moroccan Law 09-08 on personal data protection.

q2.question: Does JURIJOB offer services beyond shortlisting?
q2.answer: Yes. In addition, SLA can conduct pre-qualification interviews (paid service) to evaluate candidates prior to your own interviews. Other services available on request include executive search, custom employment contract drafting, and HR legal audits. Email recruitment@sentissilegal.com for custom inquiries.
